testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/lake/operations -q
testResults.result: 14 passed: coverage/failure/queue-age/storage/budget summary composition, paused-state population, deterministic byte-identical serialization, injected RecordingAlertChannel and HttpAlertChannel transport, and the JSON application entrypoint with --dry-run

testResults.name: lint-format-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check . && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check . && uv run --extra dev ty check
testResults.result: ruff check all passed; 565 files already formatted; ty check all passed

limitations: The command composes over local market-lake state and an empty in-memory job/dead-letter store; the hosted scheduled invocation still needs Azure-backed dead-letter and storage-usage adapters
Alert delivery only opens a socket when LAKE_OPERATIONS__ALERT_URL is set; otherwise the report is emitted to stdout and a recording channel
True queue age is a lower bound: QueueMessage/JobRecord carry no enqueue instant, so JobRecord.created_at is the proxy
